q: What is Eazli?
a: Eazli is an AI‑powered shopping and design platform that helps you discover, design, and purchase products and services for your space—without the overwhelm of endless browsing.

q: Is Eazli a marketplace, a design service, or both?
a: Both. Eazli combines intelligent design guidance with a curated marketplace, so you can explore ideas, refine decisions, and purchase confidently in one place.

q: Does Eazli sell the products/services directly?
a: Eazli operates primarily as a marketplace/intermediary. Products and services are provided by independent sellers/service providers, and Eazli facilitates discovery, ordering, payment (where applicable), coordination, and support.

q: How does Eazli work from start to finish?
a: You can browse freely or start with a specific need. Eazli's AI agents help clarify your goals, suggest designs or products, refine options based on your feedback, and guide you through checkout, delivery, installation, and after‑sales support.

q: Who is Eazli designed for?
a: Eazli is designed for homeowners and renters, first‑time buyers and experienced shoppers, and anyone furnishing one item or multiple spaces.

q: Do I need design or technical experience?
a: No. Eazli is built to work whether you know exactly what you want or have no idea where to start.

q: How involved do I need to be?
a: As involved as you want. You can be hands‑on and collaborative, or hands‑off and let Eazli guide the process.

q: Is Eazli free to browse?
a: Yes. You can explore categories, ideas, and products without any obligation to buy.

q: What makes Eazli different from shopping on my own?
a: Instead of endless scrolling and second‑guessing, Eazli helps narrow options, explains why recommendations work, and supports you through decisions, ordering, and delivery.

q: Can I use Eazli for small projects or multiple spaces?
a: Yes. Eazli supports single items, full rooms, and multiple projects under one account.

q: Is Eazli available everywhere?
a: Availability may vary by product, seller, inventory, and delivery region.

q: Do you support international delivery?
a: International delivery may be available for eligible items. Delivery timelines, customs clearance requirements, and any applicable import duties/taxes (if applicable) vary by destination and will be disclosed before you confirm your purchase.

q: What are Eazli's AI agents?
a: Eazli uses specialized AI agents that act like in‑store assistants—helping you design, compare, and buy with confidence.

q: What does the Designer Agent do?
a: The Designer Agent helps translate your needs, space, style, and budget into tailored design suggestions and product combinations.

q: What does the Seller Agent do?
a: The Seller Agent manages product availability, pricing, order confirmation, delivery coordination, and after‑sales steps.

q: How do the agents work together?
a: They collaborate behind the scenes so your design choices align with what can actually be purchased, delivered, and installed.

q: Will I need to manage multiple agents?
a: No. You interact through one seamless experience.

q: Can I give feedback or request changes?
a: Yes. You can request revisions, override suggestions, or refine preferences at any time.

q: Do the agents replace humans?
a: No. They enhance the experience by combining automation with vetted sellers, designers, and service providers.

q: What if I don't like a suggestion?
a: You can reject it, ask for alternatives, or change direction entirely. The agents adapt to your feedback.

q: Are AI recommendations professional advice?
a: No. AI suggestions are for guidance only and may be incomplete or incorrect. Always review and verify before relying on them, especially for measurements, installation, safety, or compliance. Purchases are confirmed only after your approval, and you can request human support anytime.

q: Can I upload inspiration images, links, or descriptions?
a: Yes. You can upload visuals, describe ideas in words, or start with nothing at all.

q: Are designs customized to my space and lifestyle?
a: Yes. Designs consider your space, use, preferences, and budget.

q: Can I request specific brands or exclude styles?
a: Yes. You can request or exclude brands, materials, styles, or price ranges.

q: How many options will I receive?
a: You may receive a few strong recommendations or multiple variations—depending on your preference.

q: Can I make changes and approve designs before buying?
a: Yes. Nothing is purchased until you approve.

q: Can designs fit my budget and existing furniture?
a: Yes. Designs can be adjusted to your budget and incorporate items you already own.

q: Can I save, revisit, or reuse designs later?
a: Yes. You can pause projects, save designs, and return anytime.

q: How do I place an order?
a: Once you approve items, you check out directly on Eazli.

q: Are prices shown upfront?
a: Yes. Prices, taxes, and shipping (where applicable) are shown before payment.

q: Are there hidden fees?
a: No. Any applicable fees are disclosed before you confirm.

q: What payment methods are accepted?
a: Available payment methods are shown at checkout.

q: Can I cancel or change an order?
a: This depends on the order stage. If cancellation isn't possible, eligible items can be returned after delivery.

q: Will I receive confirmation?
a: Yes. You'll receive an order confirmation and receipt.

q: How long does delivery take?
a: Delivery timelines vary by product and seller. An estimated timeline is shown before purchase.

q: Can I track my order?
a: Yes. Track status and updates in Account → Orders.

q: Does Eazli coordinate delivery and installation?
a: Yes, where offered. Eazli supports scheduling and coordination.

q: What if delivery is delayed or incomplete?
a: Contact Eazli support and we'll investigate and resolve.

q: What is the return policy?
a: For eligible items, you can request a return within 7 days from delivery for change-of-mind returns (where allowed). Custom or made-to-order items are usually non-returnable and are clearly marked.

q: Who pays return shipping?
a: If the issue is damage, defect, or wrong item, the seller covers it. For change‑of‑mind returns, the customer pays return fees (shown before confirming).

q: Are custom or made‑to‑order items returnable?
a: Usually no. These items are clearly marked.

q: How are refunds issued?
a: Refunds go to the original payment method after approval. Timing depends on your bank.

q: What if something is missing, damaged, or not delivered?
a: Report it immediately. Eazli will investigate and support the resolution process.

q: How do I contact support?
a: Use the in‑app Help option or email support@eazli.com.

q: Is my data and payment information secure?
a: Yes. Eazli uses secure systems and complies with applicable data‑privacy laws.

q: Is my data shared?
a: Only what's necessary to fulfill orders (e.g., delivery/contact details) is shared with sellers/logistics partners. You can request access, correction, or deletion where applicable.

q: Are sellers and installers vetted?
a: Yes. Eazli monitors performance and takes action when standards aren't met.

q: How fast must I confirm orders?
a: Within 24 hours. Unconfirmed orders may auto‑cancel and may count as an SLA breach.

q: What happens if I can't fulfill an order?
a: Cancel immediately through the vendor portal and provide a reason.

q: Are returns mandatory?
a: Yes. Eligible returns within 7 days must be accepted. Non-returnable categories (e.g., custom/made-to-order where applicable) must be clearly labeled upfront and handled per the policy.

q: Who processes refunds?
a: Eazli Finance executes refunds. Vendors provide inspection evidence.

q: What counts as proof of delivery?
a: Depending on method: signature, OTP, photos, GPS/time stamps, or courier confirmation.

q: What if a customer reports non‑delivery or damage?
a: Vendors must respond quickly with required documentation. Non‑response may result in force decisions.

q: Where do I receive tickets?
a: Through the vendor portal or official Eazli communications. Always respond through approved channels.

q: What happens if I miss SLAs?
a: Eazli may proceed with resolution to protect customers, and breaches may affect vendor performance scores.
